 Delmarva Now | The Daily Times MD in person early voting ends Thursday. Where to do it on Lower Shore
 Keith Demko, Salisbury Daily Times Thu, October 29, 2026 at 9:04 AM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. On the evening of Oct. 24, 2026, area fire departments were dispatched to a reported house fire on Hunters Mill Drive in Salisbury, within Hebron Volunteer Fire Department’s first-due response area (Station 5). Fire crews from Salisbury, Westside, Mardela Springs and Fruitland responded to assist with the incident. Upon arrival, Deputy Chief Lecates found a lawnmower on fire in the garage area of the residence. Due to the presence of gasoline in the area, the fire quickly intensified, heavily involving the garage and extending into the home. Firefighters worked for several hours to bring the incident under control and complete overhaul operations to ensure the fire was fully extinguished. The Maryland State Police and the Office of the Maryland State Fire Marshal also responded to the scene to investigate. One individual was taken into custody in connection with the incident on suspicion of arson. (WAYNE BARRALL PHOTOS) The Maryland State Board of Elections reminds voters that in-person early voting in the Gubernatorial General Election ends Thursday, Oct. 29.
 "With early voting coming to a close, I encourage Marylanders who have not yet cast their ballot to take advantage of this convenient opportunity," said Jared DeMarinis, State Administrator of Elections. "Voters can find their nearest early voting center and plan their visit by going to our website or using the free Go Vote Maryland! app."
 Early voting will run from 7 a.m. to 8 p.m. Thursday. Voters in line by 8 p.m. can cast a ballot. A list of early voting centers is available online at vote.md.gov/vote2026 .

 Early voting is one of three options to cast your ballot in this election. The other two are mail-in voting and in-person voting on Election Day, Tuesday, November 3.
